preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= len(s) <= 10**6 for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string s in test cases has a length between 2 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '()[]' for c in s) for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string s in test_cases contains only the characters '(', ')', '[', and ']'

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= q <= 2 * 10**5 for q in queries_count)
preconditions.description: The number of queries q for each test case is between 1 and 2 * 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= l < r <= len(s) for l, r in queries) for s, queries in zip(test_cases, queries_list))
preconditions.description: For each query (l, r), 1 <= l < r <= length of the corresponding string s.

preconditions.expression: all(all((r - l) % 2 == 0 for l, r in queries) for queries in queries_list)
preconditions.description: For each query (l, r), the length of the substring s[l:r] is even.
The sum of the lengths of all strings in all test cases does not exceed 10^6.
The sum of all q (number of queries) in all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(cost, int) and cost >= 0 for costs in output for cost in costs)
postconditions.description: Each output cost is a non-negative integer.
The number of output lists matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(len(costs) == q for costs, q in zip(output, queries_count))
postconditions.description: Each output list has the same number of costs as the number of queries for the corresponding test case.
